description: Portrait of O'Keeffe on her portal at Ghost Ranch brushing her black chow, Beau, on a wooden table. O'Keeffe leaning over the table in profile, hair pulled back, wearing a white dress with a white apron and  gardening gloves (or possibly rubber gloves) while brushing the dog. Vigas, adobe walls, door and window visible.
title: O'Keeffe Brushing Beau
